target_cwe.cwe_name: Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes ('Prototype Pollution')
target_cwe.description: The product receives input from an upstream component that specifies attributes that are to be initialized or updated in an object, but it does not properly control modifications of attributes of the object prototype.
remediation_steps: Implement comprehensive input validation and sanitization
Use whitelisting approach for acceptable inputs

stage3_hypothesis.cwe_name: Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes ('Prototype Pollution')
stage3_hypothesis.fit_reason: The key manipulation process could potentially lead to prototype pollution if the keys are used in object attribute contexts, though less directly related than CWE-99.
